open_items: SPC: cycle 1486 provider_down, HTTP 502 on every path (gateway + direct, metadata + data + json) plus 11 broken contract assertions in the same cycle. Live recheck ~44 min later: direct metadata and data paths both 200. New shape, not seen before in 48h history; resolved by the time of this run. Watch next cycle to confirm it does not recur.

ILO: chronic Cloudflare/WAF-shaped 403 pattern recurred at cycle 1486 (gateway data probe only, single check, matches the known shape, not the both-paths-at-once severe variant from cycle 1474). Live recheck confirms recovery. Not a gateway code bug; nothing to fix. Watch for the both-paths-at-once shape or multi-cycle persistence recurring.

ESTAT: list_dataflows 60s call-deadline timeout recurred at cycle 1486 (also seen at 1484, 1469, 1467, 1464, 1463). Live recheck: direct listing took ~31s, under deadline. Working as designed, not a bug.
SBS: DNS-resolution failure on the gateway path. Still only one occurrence (cycle 1462, recovered by 1463) in the last 240+ hours of history through 1486.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py lines 208-210 catching Exception and returning bare str(e)): most recently traced on ESTAT at cycle 1467. No new occurrence through 1486. Still unfixed; recommend logging repr(e) or type(e).__name__ instead of str(e).
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1486 (confirmed by /api/contracts this run). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
IMF: single-cycle both-path 401 episode at cycle 1458, resolved by 1459. No new occurrence through 1486.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 162 as of this run, still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. SPC's cycle-1486 contract breakage did show up in both this time, so no new confirmation needed, but the underlying bug is unfixed.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped) when the endpoint is otherwise healthy; encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time across endpoints, verdict stays ok.
